A resolved merge can have no index diff (Accept Left). Included, non-conflicted MERGING repositories still require a two-parent commit. Keep them in the original staging workflow's commit roots without allowing arbitrary empty commits or excluded roots.

val rootsToCommit get() = state.rootsToCommit + state.includedRoots.filter { root ->
    root !in state.conflictedRoots &&
      git4idea.repo.GitRepositoryManager.getInstance(project).getRepositoryForRootQuick(root)?.state ==
      com.intellij.dvcs.repo.Repository.State.MERGING
  }
